headline: No date confirmed yet for the coming Sunday
detail: Apps Court Farm's car boot page still carries the banner "THE CAR BOOT IS OPEN THIS SUNDAY", unchanged from the check on Friday 18 September, when it confirmed Sunday 20 September. That date has now passed and the farm has not yet posted a notice for the coming Sunday, so we are not treating any specific date as confirmed. There is no postponement or cancellation notice on the page. The farm states its car boot sales are held every Sunday and on all Spring, Summer and early Winter Bank Holiday Mondays, weather dependent, but it does not publish a fixed calendar: dates are posted at the top of that page weekly, usually by Friday. Gates open at 7am for sellers and the sale closes at 1pm. Check the banner on the official page or call 01932 244 822 for the recorded status before travelling.
